title: Prisma in Next.js App Router
description: Use Prisma Client in Next.js App Router Server Components and understand where database access is allowed.

data.text: Next.js App Router Server Components can directly access Prisma Client because they run on the server. This eliminates the need for separate API routes for database access in many cases.

data.title: Server Component with Prisma
data.content: Fetch posts in a Server Component.

items: **Server Components** — Direct database access is allowed
**Server Actions** — Database access is allowed and runs on the server
**Client Components** — Never import Prisma; use Server Actions or Route Handlers instead

data.title: Warning
data.text: Never import Prisma Client in a client component ('use client'). This will expose your database schema to the browser and break the application.
